the officers and directors of the Surviving Company shall be authorized to execute and deliver, in the name and on behalf of the Company or the Merger Subsidiaries, any deeds, bills of sale, assignments or assurances and to take any other actions and do any other things, in the name and on behalf of the Company or the Merger Subsidiaries, as may be reasonably necessary to vest, perfect or confirm of record or otherwise in the Surviving Company any and all right, title and interest in, to and under any of the rights, properties or assets of the Company acquired or to be acquired by the Surviving Company as a result of, or in connection with, the Mergers.

attributes.covenant_obligor: the officers and directors of the Surviving Company
